frame: body FRD (x nose, y right wing, z down); stations aft from nose

tables.airframe_alpha.csv: propeller-off airframe, beta=0; CL/CD wind axes, Cm about reference station
tables.airframe_beta.csv: propeller-off airframe, alpha=0; CY body y, Cl/Cn about reference station, span-normalised
tables.rotor.csv: per rotor: T = CT rho n^2 D^4, Q = CQ rho n^2 D^5, J = V_axial/(n D), n in rev/s
tables.vane.csv: jet side force / unit thrust and axial thrust loss / unit thrust vs vane deflection

derivative_notes: damping uses hat rates q c/(2V), p b/(2V), r b/(2V); elevon_sym: both trailing edges down positive; elevon_diff = (left - right)/2, positive rolls right

rotor.spin: upper CCW, lower CW seen from the nose (assumption)
